title: UART Deep Dive
subtitle: Hardware and software serial, RS-232, and GPS modules

content.text: UART is the foundation of serial communication. It uses two wires: TX (transmit) and RX (receive). Devices communicate asynchronously at a matching baud rate.
Arduino Uno has one hardware UART (pins 0/1, shared with USB). Use SoftwareSerial for additional devices.

questions.question: What is the purpose of RX and TX pins in UART?
questions.explanation: TX is the transmit pin (output) and RX is the receive pin (input). Connect TX of one device to RX of the other.

faq.a: RS-232 is an older serial standard using ±12V logic levels (vs 0/3.3V or 0/5V for modern TTL UART). A MAX232 chip converts between them.
